description.ja: TVアニメ『新機動戦記ガンダム W』より、総勢40機からなるMS部隊マグアナック隊の一般機をHGACで立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "Mobile Suit Gundam W", the general aircraft of the MS unit Maguanak Corps, which consists of 40 aircraft, are made into three-dimensional by HGAC!

description.ja: • 「Fine Build」のコンセプトをもとに、組み立てやすさを追求した構造を採用。
description.en: • Based on the concept of "Fine Build", we have adopted a structure that pursues ease of assembly.

description.ja: • シールドはバックパックに、ヒートトマホークは腰部にマウントが可能。
description.en: • Seal can be mounted on a backpack, and Heat Tomahawk can be mounted on the waist.

description.ja: • ショルダーアーマーの跳ね上げギミックを搭載。
description.en: • Equipped with a flip-up gimmick for shoulder armor.

series: New Mobile Report Gundam W series
